fn_classes.mechanism: ORGANIZATION regex only matches corporate-suffix forms; institutional proper names (321), acronyms 'PKK'/'RHA' (74), and keyword-bearing names it still misses (26) produce nothing. No pool engine emits an ORG label at all: GLiNERAdapter._PII_LABELS omits 'organization' and presidio ships no ORG recognizer — the gap is unreachable by today's swarm regardless of fusion.
examples: concluded by the Royal Free Hospital School of Medicine, <<University of London>>
he denied that he had been involved in the <<PKK>>
fn_classes.remediation: Extend the GLiNER queried-label set with 'organization' (adapter-local, one list entry + label map) and/or add an NER engine emitting ORGANIZATION; regex alone cannot reach this class.

fn_classes.name: bare-toponym-location
fn_classes.mechanism: LOCATION/ADDRESS natives are address-shaped (street/number/zip); bare country/city names in prose ('Somalia', 'Mardin', 'London') never fire (LOC relaxed recall 0.022). Needs gazetteer or NER — presidio solo already reaches LOC relaxed recall 0.678 in-pool.
examples: land in <<Ceylanpınar>> in the south-east of Turkey
fn_classes.remediation: Surface presidio LOCATION through fusion + add a PresidioAdapter label-normalization map (LOCATION->pii-anon LOCATION); a country/major-city gazetteer pattern is a cheaper partial alternative.

fn_classes.name: demographic-attribute-prose
fn_classes.mechanism: The GDPR Art-9/demographic natives (NATIONALITY, JOB_TITLE, AGE, MARITAL_STATUS, HEALTH_CONDITION) are labeled-field/value-list oriented and near-zero on prose (DEM recall 0.011): occupations 253 ('owner', 'teacher'), nationality phrases 144 ('a Turkish national', 'national of Nigeria'), age/birth-year 57, marital 32 ('widow'), health 15.
examples: the applicant was the <<owner>> and editor of a local newspaper
fn_classes.remediation: Prose grammars for the reachable subclasses: demonym+national/citizen collocation, 'worked as a <occupation>', marital-status lexicon, 'age of N'/'N years old'; health/occupation open classes need NER (presidio NRP gives DEM 0.234 solo).

fn_classes.name: labeled-docket-registry-number
fn_classes.mechanism: ECHR application numbers 'no. NNNNN/YY' (285) plus 'no.'-anchored registry/plot numbers (43) don't match any COURT_CASE_NUMBER/DOCKET_NUMBER format. The label anchor ('application (no. …)', 'plot no.') is present in-text — a labeled-number context grammar is fully pattern-reachable and generalizes to any docketed-document domain.
examples: originated in an application (no. <<16757/90>>) against the United Kingdom
fn_classes.remediation: Add slash-format NNNNN/YY to the case-number family and a generic 'no(s). <digits>' labeled-number pattern gated on a document-register context word.

fn_classes.name: monetary-and-count-quantity
fn_classes.mechanism: No native covers bare monetary amounts (117: 'DKK 275,000', '88,674 zlotys' — SALARY demands salary context) or counts of persons/events (126+49: 'fifteen others', 'six votes to one'). Currency amounts are pattern-reachable (ISO code/currency word + amount); spelled-out counts need document-level reasoning about identifying force.
examples: sentenced him to pay a fine of <<DKK 275,000>>
fn_classes.remediation: MONETARY_AMOUNT pattern capability (currency-token anchored); leave count expressions to doc-level — pattern-chasing them would flood precision.

fn_classes.name: anonymized-party-initial
fn_classes.mechanism: Court-anonymized party references — bare initials 'W.', 'C.Ç', 'K' (59) and rank+initial 'Corporal G', 'Captain J' (22) — fall below the 2-capitalized-token person pattern. GLiNER finds several ('Mrs G.', 'W.') and fusion discards them. A titled/rank+single-initial grammar is precision-safe; bare single letters without title are not.
examples: the failure to hear the evidence of <<W.>>
He asked that Captain J and <<Corporal G>> be called
fn_classes.remediation: Extend PERSON_NAME grammar with honorific/rank + initial(s) forms ('Mr X.', 'Corporal G'); leave untitled single letters to NER/doc-level coreference.

fn_classes.name: prose-name-missed-needs-ner
fn_classes.mechanism: Fully missed real names: unusual shapes ('Mummery LJ', 'Mr Ütebay'), 28 with non-ASCII diacritics, 5 all-caps. Regex name heuristics cap out; GLiNER solo reaches PERSON relaxed recall 0.755 vs the shipped pipeline's 0.447 — the capability exists in-pool and is destroyed by fusion (see swarm delta).
examples: For practical reasons, <<Mr Ütebay>> will continue to be called "the applicant"
fn_classes.remediation: Fix the fusion discard (below) rather than the regex: gliner already finds most of these with P=0.911.

fn_classes.name: entity-found-span-convention
fn_classes.mechanism: Name/org found but offsets differ from gold. Two sub-mechanisms: (a) honorific-inclusion boundary ('Turgut Köklü' vs gold 'Mr Turgut Köklü') — absorbed by relaxed matching, pure convention artifact (vanilla 357, swarm 320 incl. ORG); (b) initial-truncation: the pattern stops after a middle initial ('Mr E.' vs gold 'Mr E. Abrahamson', IoU<0.5 so it fails even relaxed) — a real tokenization gap (vanilla 402, swarm 397).
examples: gold <<Mr S. GRODZINSKI>> (all-caps surname breaks the run)
fn_classes.remediation: (a) is scoring-convention only — do not chase; (b) let the name grammar continue across 'Title? Initial. Surname' including all-caps and diacritic surnames.

fn_classes.name: misc-catchall-unreachable
fn_classes.mechanism: TAB MISC = 'any other identifying description' (events, quantities of land, vernacular terms); deliberately left unmapped in PRED_MAP because no native honestly corresponds to a catch-all. 20+ of its spans duplicate PERSON/DEM gold at identical offsets under a second type (union-of-annotators).
examples: a pain condition in connection with <<dental problems>>
one residence of an area of <<219.41 sq. m>>
fn_classes.remediation: Not fixable at detector level — taxonomy/mapping decision; any credit here requires document-level reasoning over 'other identifying information'.

fp_classes.name: entity-correct-but-not-maskable
fp_classes.mechanism: Prediction sits exactly on a TAB-annotated mention that EVERY annotator marked NO_MASK (794 PERSON + 118 ORG + 1 LOC): the detector is right that it's an entity ('The Tribunal', 'Fourth Section', 'Benefits Agency', 'Northern Ireland'), but TAB scores what must be masked to prevent re-identification — a document-level identifiability decision no span-local detector can make. This is the honest external-validity signal, not a pattern bug.
examples: a Chamber of the <<Fourth Section>> composed of Judges Raimondi…
the applicant notified the <<Benefits Agency>> of his wife's death
against the United Kingdom of Great Britain and <<Northern Ireland>>
fp_classes.remediation: Not fixable per-span; requires a document-level maskability layer (mention salience/coreference to the data subject). For eval framing: report alongside an entity-level score so the task mismatch is visible.

fp_classes.name: capitalized-boilerplate-as-person
fp_classes.mechanism: PERSON_NAME fires on capitalized token runs with no stopword/role-noun guard: legal boilerplate ('The Court', 'Grand Chamber', 'Human Rights', 'Protocol No') 562, bare sentence-initial function words ('On', 'the', 'Article') 38, other capitalized phrases 80. Recurs in any formal document with heavy capitalization.
examples: when <<Protocol No>>. 11 to the Convention came into force
fp_classes.remediation: Stopword/determiner guard at run start, a role/legal-noun demotion lexicon, and a minimum-evidence rule (require a given-name-shaped token or honorific) in the PERSON_NAME pattern.

fp_classes.name: institution-as-person-label-confusion
fp_classes.mechanism: FP face of the FN class 'institution-name-consumed-by-person-heuristic': PERSON_NAME emitted on spans overlapping ORG (586) or other (81) gold — 'Ankara Administrative Court', 'Ministry for Foreign Affairs' typed as a person. Right region, wrong type; costs both an FP and an FN.
examples: the <<Ankara Administrative Court>> awarded compensation (pred PERSON_NAME, gold ORG)
appointed to the <<Somali Embassy>> in London
fp_classes.remediation: Same institution-keyword arbitration as the FN class — one fix, two ledger lines.

fp_classes.name: address-pattern-on-number-plus-capitalized-phrase
fp_classes.mechanism: The ADDRESS regex treats 'digits + capitalized words' as house-number+street: '1997 the Regional Court', '1 of the Rules of Court'. 377 FPs, and because the match consumes the year it also CAUSES 331 DATETIME label-confusion FNs — a single precision bug charged on both sides.
examples: On 16 June and 14 October <<1997 the Regional Court>> held further hearings (ADDRESS)
Rule 52 § <<1 of the Rules of Court>> (ADDRESS)
On 23 September <<2004 the Warsaw District Court>> gave judgment
fp_classes.remediation: Require a street-type lexeme (St/Ave/Road/Straße…), postal context, or comma-structured tail before accepting the house-number branch; reject when the number parses as a 4-digit year followed by a determiner.

fp_classes.name: gps-pattern-on-number-lists
fp_classes.mechanism: GPS_COORDINATES fires on any decimal/comma number pair: money '50,169.18', article enumerations '9, 10'. No lat/lon range check or degree-symbol/context requirement.
examples: in the sum of <<50,169.18>> pounds sterling (GPS_COORDINATES)
fp_classes.remediation: Bound the pattern to plausible lat/lon ranges and require a coordinate marker (degree sign, N/S/E/W, 'coordinates') — cheap, pure-precision win.

fp_classes.name: name-fragment-and-boundary-echo
fp_classes.mechanism: FP face of the span-convention FN class: honorific-boundary near-misses that relaxed absorbs (vanilla 328 / swarm 291) plus initial-truncated fragments failing IoU ('Mr J.', 'Ms L.' emitted next to gold 'Mr J. Wołąsiewicz') (vanilla 403 / swarm 447 — the swarm's ONLY FP growth, from gliner boundary votes reshaping clusters).
examples: pred <<Mr J.>> vs gold 'Mr J. Wołąsiewicz'
pred <<Ms L.>> vs gold 'Ms L. Scott-Moncrieff'
pred <<Commission Mr Gaukur>> (run bleeds across role word into the name)
fp_classes.remediation: Same 'Title Initial. Surname' grammar fix as the FN side; also stop capitalized runs from bleeding across role nouns ('Commission', 'Delegate').

fp_classes.name: public-institution-org
fp_classes.mechanism: ORGANIZATION correctly fires on public bodies ('The Commission', 'European Commission') that TAB does not annotate at all — court-machinery boilerplate, not identifying information about the applicant. Distinct from the NO_MASK class: these aren't mentions in the gold annotation layer.
examples: lodged with the <<European Commission>> of Human Rights
<<The Commission>>'s request referred to Articles 44 and 48
fp_classes.remediation: Not a detector defect for masking purposes (over-masking boilerplate is safe); for benchmark precision only a well-known-institution allowlist would help — low priority.

result.swarm_delta_note: Swarm ≈ vanilla on TAB: strict tp 364 vs 322 (the whole delta is +42 PERSON boundary refinements, e.g. gliner votes pulling 'Mr Turgut Köklü' to gold offsets), relaxed identical at R 0.091, and swarm ADDS 44 PERSON fragment FPs. Measured pre- vs post-fusion (all 127 docs): GLiNER solo emits 934 PERSON_NAME findings at P=0.911/R=0.125 (PERSON relaxed recall 0.755 vs pipeline 0.452), yet fusion DISCARDS 442 of its 892 gold-matching findings (49.6%) — exact-span hits like 'Mr S. Esmer', 'Mr Osman Çağlayan', 'Mrs G.', 'Glasgow, Scotland' (full list: scratchpad/gliner_discarded.json). Presidio solo: relaxed R=0.530 (DATETIME 0.918 vs swarm 0.0, LOC 0.678, PERSON 0.692, DEM/NRP 0.234) and ZERO survives fusion. Mechanism (verified on doc 0: 63 presidio + 5 gliner findings in, fused output = exactly the 29 regex findings): Layer-3 trained calibration (~/.pii_anon/swarm ds_params/temperature/informativeness) pushes single-engine meta_scores below the 0.50 emission_threshold; SEMANTIC_TYPES (PERSON_NAME/LOCATION/ADDRESS/…) additionally require corroboration_count>=2 or meta>=0.85; cross-engine corroboration is further broken by label-vocabulary mismatch (presidio emits PERSON/LOCATION/DATE_TIME/NRP verbatim — PresidioAdapter has no native-label normalization, so presidio types split the type vote and, even if emitted, PERSON/LOCATION/NRP key into no PRED_MAP native). The floor-projection then re-injects regex spans, locking the swarm to the regex floor on prose. Union counterfactual regex∪gliner∪presidio(mapped): relaxed R 0.091→0.582, P 0.171→0.452, F2 ≈0.10→≈0.55 — the recall for the top FN classes already exists inside the pool; the general remediation is fusion behavior (calibration coverage for prose engines + label normalization at the adapter seam), not new patterns. Analysis artifacts: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-subhashholla-Development-pii-anonymize-pseudonymize-pii-anon-core-pii-anon-code/a02504b7-c72d-487f-bb5b-7d1686e50fcc/scratchpad/ (mine_tab.py, classify_tab.py, engine_probe.py, tab_mine_*.json, tab_classes_*.json, gliner_discarded.json).
result.gold_noise_note: Union-of-annotators gold carries 217 spans with 2+ entity types at identical offsets (446 of 7160 gold slots, 6.2%) — a prediction can strictly match at most one, structurally inflating FN; dominant type-pairs LOC/ORG (52), DATETIME/DEM (48, birth years), MISC duplicating PERSON/DEM (38). 33 PERSON gold spans are bare 1-2 letter tokens without a period ('K'), and at least one is mis-anchored on a sentence-initial function word ('<<A>> total of about 90 hearings' marked PERSON because a co-defendant is called A) — unreachable for any precision-safe detector; treat as noise floor (~1-2% of PERSON gold), do not pattern-chase. The 454-span MISC class and the 913 all-annotator-NO_MASK FP hits are task-definition semantics (maskability, not entity-hood), disclosed as convention, not counted as noise.

candidates.title: Title-Case-phrase PERSON_NAME FP suppression stack (field-label position veto + common-word filter + evidence requirement)
candidates.expected_impact: Single largest precision lever, present in 5/5 datasets: 369 (ai4p, ~40% of strict FPs) + 5,906 (nemotron, 71% of all FPs) + 8,270 (gretel, 71% of all FPs) + 680 (TAB) + 364 (home) = ~15,589 vanilla strict FPs, plus ~965 adjacent ORG-heading FPs (gretel 637 industry-noun headings, nemotron 328 org-on-headers) if the same heading/label-position veto is shared. Home benefits directly (364 of its 1,019 FPs are this class).
candidates.implementation_sketch: Three stacked suppressors in the capitalized-run PERSON recognizers: (a) field-label position veto — reject a Title-Case phrase immediately followed by ':' or '|', or wrapped in markdown '**'/heading markers (pairs with candidate 11's structure pass, or cheap local char checks); (b) common-English-word filter — reject when ALL tokens sit in a corpus-frequency list (derivable from public prose or upstream TRAIN splits, never test gold); (c) start-of-run stopword/determiner/role-noun guard ('The Court', 'On', 'United States District') + require a given-name-lexicon or honorific evidence token for context-free bare bigrams. Share the heading/list-position veto with the ORGANIZATION industry-noun pattern.
candidates.risk: This is a masking-path suppressor, so the failure direction is under-masking real names that happen to be common words ('Summer Rose'); mitigate by requiring label-position OR all-tokens-common rather than either alone, and keep the given-name-lexicon override. Gate on the home floor: home R must stay >= 0.9022 (expected net home gain since 364 home FPs are this class and home gold names are conventional). Not an eval-time-only drop — intrinsic detector precision rule, sp2 leak-direction rule satisfied but the residual under-mask risk must be documented in the assurance report.

candidates.title: Per-(engine,type) single-engine acceptance in swarm fusion (replace the blanket SEMANTIC_TYPES corroboration gate)
candidates.expected_impact: Largest measured recall headroom in the program: TAB union counterfactual regex∪gliner∪presidio lifts relaxed R 0.091→0.582 and F2 ≈0.10→≈0.55 (7,160 gold); ai4privacy gliner pre-fusion matches 597/1436 gold but only 298 survive (≈300 reachable spans thrown away); gretel prose probe loses 152/780 gliner-matched gold post-fusion (street_address-dominant — attacks the 726-span largest gretel FN class); nemotron probe discards 26 IoU-1.0 gold hits per 30 records; home discards 30 incl. conf 0.93–0.95 findings.

Add post-fusion plausibility gates for admitted ML findings: word-boundary span starts (fixes mid-word 'Col<<leen Redding>>'), calendar-valid dates (fixes DATE_TIME on '1526-32-18-49'), alphabetic-word requirement for LOC-typed findings (fixes 46 home LOC-on-base64/EIN FPs). Keep FloorProjectingFusion untouched.

candidates.title: Labeled-field value extractor: shared tolerant cue-to-value bridge + label-wins type arbitration + cue-capture hygiene

NNNNN/YY' + 149 'born in YYYY'; home ≈250 (encoded-in-labeled-field 63, DOB-cue 38, config credentials 23, income 33, phone-over-labeled-account 68, tax-id arbitration 27).
